_what: The perf ladder's regression baseline — M154e step 5, see scripts/verify-perf-baseline.mjs.
_bands: Ratios of tflw to its co-runner in the SAME run (D750), never absolute numbers: absolutes on this box move with thermal state, the 2.4 GHz link and whoever else holds the lease. A null band is NOT 'unmeasured' — every rung here was measured. It means the derivation declined to draw one, and _notes says why for each.
_establishing: Established 2026-08-26, closing B6-15 ("reopens when the parity ladder is next run in anger"). Derived by scripts/derive-perf-bands.mjs from the runs in _sources, all committed under founding-runs/ so these bands can be re-derived rather than taken on trust. Contribution is per-rung, not per-run: the apiV2 rungs rest on the two clean runs, and the echo-* rungs on three, because the third run's apiV2 died while its stateless echo target stayed healthy. Re-derive as more runs accumulate — n=2 cannot estimate variance, so the half-width is floored at 25% rather than computed.
_method: Bands drawn by scripts/derive-perf-bands.mjs from 3 clean runs: geometric centre, half-width max(observed spread ^ 0.5 * 1.2, 1.25) capped at 1.7. Re-derive rather than hand-editing.

_notes.dogfood-get-only.p95Ratio: not banded: tflw reported a p95 of 3/3 ms, so its +/-0.5 ms integer-reporting quantum is 17% of the reading — over the 10% share at which a band would fail on rounding rather than on behaviour (M154f-12).
_notes.echo-get-only.p95Ratio: not banded: tflw reported a p95 of 1/1/1 ms, so its +/-0.5 ms integer-reporting quantum is 50% of the reading — over the 10% share at which a band would fail on rounding rather than on behaviour (M154f-12).
